i1.title: Franck Olivier Bella In Paris Eau de Parfum 75ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A sunny Parisian bouquet of fruit and flowers.

Franck Olivier Bella In Paris Eau de Parfum 75ml is a fruity floral fragrance for women. Juicy orange, peach and pear open it bright and sweet, a heart of iris, magnolia and rose brings an elegant floral bouquet, and it settles into a soft, warm base of cedar, musk and sandalwood.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Orange, Peach, Pear
  • Heart: Iris, Magnolia, Rose
  • Base: Cedar, Musk, Sandalwood

Key details

  • Brand: Franck Olivier
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 75ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Woody
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy orange, peach and pear opening
  • An elegant iris, magnolia and rose heart
  • A soft cedar, musk and sandalwood base
  • Generous 75ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Bella In Paris smell like?

Orange, peach and pear first, then iris, magnolia and rose, finishing with cedar, musk and sandalwood.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.

i2.title: Franck Olivier Eau de Passion Men Eau de Toilette 75ml
